_readme.what: Every Velogames Fantasy Cycling Tour de France artefact collected for the AP39 quantum-fantasy-cycling posts, 2023-2026, in one file.
_readme.round_scheme: 22 rounds per rider: stages 1-21 plus a final "Final Classifications" round.

game_rules.note: Rules confirmed from the 2026 rules page and assumed unchanged for earlier editions. Recent editions also run a separate Replacements contest (7 transfers across 3 windows) which is NOT covered by any data here.

validation.rider_totals: PASS 720/720 - every rider's 22 round totals sum to their published season total, all four editions.
validation.component_rows: 46 rows of 15,840 (0.29%) in 2024 and 2025 have component columns that do not sum to their own row total, 40 of them in the Final Classifications round. Net -25 pts (2024), -495 pts (2025). This is Velogames' own published data, not a scraping error - the same rows reproduce identically via two independent scrapers. 2023 and 2026 are internally perfect.
validation.authority: Round totals (tot) and season totals are authoritative. The 8-component split is not, for those 46 rows.

derived_fields.hindsight_optimum: Exact ILP/knapsack over final points under the real squad constraints. Cross-checked two ways (per-class 0/1 knapsack DP and PuLP/CBC) with identical results.
derived_fields.stage_type: ITT/TTT come from Velogames' own stage labels. All other stages are classified empirically from outcomes: sprint = sprinters took >=40% of stage-result points; mountain = climbers + all-rounders took >=65%; otherwise mixed. This describes who scored, NOT the official parcours profile.
derived_fields.winning_score: Top score on the public Classic (Main) leaderboard. Public board shows the top ~300 teams only.

_readme.companion_csvs: The same data is also present as flat CSVs alongside this file (velogames-all-riders.csv, velogames-all-scores.csv, velogames-all-stages.csv, and per-edition splits).

ap39_2026_entry.note: The team the QAOA/ILP work picked for the 2026 edition, per the quantum-tour-de-france-fantasy post.
